alt: Comparing two substrings of the same text by hash instead of character by character. A prefix hash array lets either window's hash be read in O(1), without rebuilding it. Two presets: one where the substrings are equal and their hashes agree, one where they differ and the hashes disagree.

steps.caption: hash_a = window_hash(0, 3) reads prefix_hash directly: prefix_hash[3] - prefix_hash[0] * powers[3] = 96354. No character of this window is rebuilt.
hash_a and hash_b agree at 96354. Checking the characters confirms it: "abc" equals "abc", reported equal.
hash_a = window_hash(0, 3) reads prefix_hash directly: prefix_hash[3] - prefix_hash[0] * powers[3] = 96354. No character of this window is rebuilt.
hash_a and hash_b differ, so the windows cannot be equal: "abc" and "bca" are reported different without comparing a single character.
